subject: computer
source: CISCE Curriculum for Primary Classes I-V (2016), official

covers: Define a computer system as hardware and software working together
Tell hardware (the physical parts) from software (the programs)
Explain the IPO model: input, process and output
Name the parts of the CPU: control unit, memory unit and arithmetic logic unit
Explain why software is needed to make hardware work
Name some common application software
Explain what an operating system does
Know the terms GUI, windows, buttons and icons
Name the desktop parts: icons, taskbar and start button
Open, move and arrange desktop icons, and change the wallpaper and screensaver
Tell safe mode from normal mode
Log in and shut down the computer in the right order
List the types of operating system and what each does
Explain the purpose of a word processor
Name the parts of the word processor window
Create, save and close a file
Tell Save from Save As
Open and edit an existing file
Respect others' files and never open or change them without permission
Explain what the internet is and what it is used for
List the advantages and disadvantages of the internet
Know basic words: browser, website, webpage, home page and search engine
Open a website by typing its web address
Follow best practices and online safety rules
Act as a responsible digital citizen
Use Paint tools such as the colour picker and free-form selection
Copy, move and resize parts of a picture
Save files in formats such as .png and .jpg
Explain what a folder is
Create, save and open a file and a folder
Save a file in a folder using a path
